contact_email_preheader: Reply directly to this message. Your reply goes to the sender.
contact_email_intro: a visitor of {siteName} sent a message for {entryName}.
contact_email_reply_note: If you reply to this message, the reply goes straight to the sender, who will then see your address. You do not have to reply. We do not keep the message on the site.
contact_email_report_prompt: Think it is spam or abuse?
contact_email_footer: You are getting this message because a visitor to {siteName} wants to contact your listing {entryName}. Your address was not shown to the sender. Do not want messages like this? Report it with the link above or write to {contactEmail}. {controllerName}.
contact_intro: Your message goes to the listing by email. Your address is shown only to the recipient, who can reply to you directly.
contact_message_hint: Up to 1,000 characters and one link. Plain text only.
contact_privacy: We do not keep your message or send you a copy. To limit abuse we keep an anonymous code made from your address for 30 days.
contact_sent_body: The listing will get your message by email. Replies come to your address.
contact_error_message_long: The message is longer than 1,000 characters.
contact_error_wait: Wait for the security check to finish, then try again.
contact_error_captcha: The security check failed. Try again.
contact_error_limit: Too many messages for now. Try again later.
contact_error_failed: The message could not be sent. Try again.
contact_error_unavailable: This listing cannot receive messages right now.
